name: corralai
description: corral: prove your tests would catch it. An auditing engine that plants faults in your code, runs your own test suite against each one in a sandbox, and records what the tests missed.

plugins.name: corral
plugins.description: Teaches your agent to run corral audits, read corral's findings over MCP, check every claim by running something, and leave the verdicts to a person. Needs the corral CLI on PATH.
